svg.aria-label: Four one-dimensional diagrams of a 3-wide kernel on 7 inputs: no padding gives 5 outputs, padding 1 keeps 7, stride 2 gives 4, and dilation 2 spreads the taps to every other input and gives 3 outputs; lines show which inputs output y2 reads
